components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressRequired"
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR/MRS/MS/DR).
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured addressLine1 is supplied it is the
            composed, normalized address returned in responses.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional second line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. When given in E.164 form the
            national-number length must match the country code: '+61' requires 9
            national digits and '+1' requires 10. A number without a country code is
            treated as Australian ('+61'), i.e. 9 national digits after dropping a
            single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 25
          pattern: '^[ ()\-./]*(?:\+[ ()\-./]*6[ ()\-./]*1(?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){9}|\+[ ()\-./]*1(?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){10}|0(?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){9}|[1-9](?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){8})[ ()\-./]*$'
          example: '0412 345 678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.DisposableEmailValidation"
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present, drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent(message = \"registrationDate must not be later than the current date\")"
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean

## Summary

I implemented owner soft-delete with minimal structural impact — small, cohesive edits rather than growing any existing method or class.

**Behavior changes**
- `DELETE /api/owners/{id}` now flags the owner `deleted = true` and saves it (retaining the row, still returning 204/2xx) instead of removing it.
- `GET /api/owners/{id}` still returns the owner afterward, now with `deleted: true`; a freshly created owner reports `deleted: false`.
- The create endpoint's duplicate/identity (and related) checks ignore soft-deleted owners, so a normally-blocking duplicate is allowed when the only match was deleted.

**Files touched (6)**
- `model/Owner.java` — added a `Boolean deleted` field plus a one-line `getDeleted()` (false when null, like `getBulkSignupWarning`) and `setDeleted(boolean)`. No existing method changed.
- `rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java` — two tiny edits: `deleteOwner` now sets the flag and calls the existing `saveOwner`; `addOwner`'s owner lookup filters out deleted owners in one statement, so every downstream check inherits the exclusion without touching each check.
- `resources/openapi.yml` — added a read-only `deleted` boolean to the `Owner` schema; MapStruct auto-maps it by name, so the mapper needed no changes.
- `resources/db/hsqldb/schema.sql` + `db/hsqldb/data.sql` — added the `deleted BOOLEAN` column and the corresponding value in the positional seed inserts (the test DB uses `ddl-auto=none`).

**Notes**
- The default `h2` runtime profile needs no schema/data edits: script init runs before Hibernate's `ddl-auto=update`, which adds the nullable `deleted` column automatically. I intentionally left the `postgres`/`mysql` schema/data files untouched to keep the change surface small since they aren't exercised by the tests or the default profile — flag if you want those kept in sync too.
- Full test suite (the 2 acceptance tests, the only tests in the repo): **BUILD SUCCESS**, 0 failures/errors.
